question.text: Arrange the given species  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>  and  <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>  in the order of        their radii

solution.text: Atomic radius decreases on going from left to right in a period. Thus size of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>></mo><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></math>  and size of anion is larger then their atoms. As  <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math>  and  <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math> are isoelectronic, therefore, size of  <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo>></mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math>
